name: Meridian Bank
greeting: Thank you for calling Meridian Bank. What error can I help you with?
_note: Fictional bank and invented error codes for demo purposes.

entries.title: Netbanking session timed out
entries.cause: Your session ended after 5 minutes of inactivity.
entries.fix: Log in again and complete the action without leaving the page idle.

entries.title: New payee cooling period
entries.cause: Transfers above 50 thousand rupees are blocked for 24 hours after adding a new payee.
entries.fix: Wait 24 hours, or send a smaller amount in the meantime.

entries.title: Debit card PIN retries exceeded
entries.cause: Too many wrong PIN entries locked your debit card.
entries.fix: Reset the PIN from the Meridian app under Cards, or at any Meridian ATM.

entries.title: UPI payment pending or failed after debit
entries.cause: The UPI payment failed at the receiver's end after your account was debited.
entries.fix: The amount is reversed automatically within 3 working days. No action is needed.

entries.title: Statement download failed
entries.cause: The statement service is busy or the date range is too large.
entries.fix: Try again in 10 minutes with a shorter date range, or request the statement by email in the app.
